acceptance.accuracy: Fewer incorrect existing matches; higher action/ID correctness; no observed lost correct matches among the positive controls. Full-judge failures and safe abstentions remain visible.
acceptance.costAndTime: Report actual token estimate, cache use, uncached estimate, input/output/reasoning tokens, median and p95 duration. A small accuracy gain with a large increase is not an automatic win.
acceptance.evidence: Shared successful web recordings; novel requests are live and logged. Same fixtures and budgets; model responses are always fresh.
acceptance.followup: Only a promising focused result proceeds to a full-suite check. Record and revert a rejected prompt.

decision: Reverted. Lower cost and faster slow-end timing do not offset fewer correct decisions and more incorrect existing matches. No full-suite run warranted.
